lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho8Fe4Si4 (reduced formula Ho2FeSi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imm2 (No. 143), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers with 10 geometric neighbors, Ho centers with 14 neighbors, and Si centers with 9 neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.54–3.34 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between Fe and Ho polyhedra, as well as corner- and face-sharing between Fe and Si polyhedra.
